title: Internship Search Automation Pipeline
summary: I designed a pipeline that searches, filters, scores, and logs engineering internship postings from a single profile file.
result: Narrowed 4,546 fetched postings to 14 relevant engineering internships with a deterministic Python search tool.
spec: Search engineering internship postings across many job boards from one profile instead of repeating the same manual searches.
A single YAML profile holds my targets, experience, and standard form answers. A Python search tool pulls postings, filters them, and passes the best matches to an AI scoring step.
Filtering narrowed 4,546 fetched postings to 14 relevant engineering internships.
Python, YAML, Notion, Claude (LLM-assisted development), Windows Task Scheduler
